snippet.title: Coding Garden with CJ
snippet.description:
Hello friends! 👋 Welcome to Coding Garden with CJ. Grow your coding skills one day at a time with tutorials, walk throughs and live coding streams about Full Stack Web Development and other related tech.

Stream Schedule:
Wednesday - 8:20 PM MDT - Code Katas

I also stream on twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/codinggarden
